answer: Operator-Bound Identity Quotas. Each operator must forge a signed enrollment certificate tying every wallet to a shared operator record and a saffron-tagged quota pool. Wallets over quota are flagged; the operator's pool is throttled and its settlement access frozen until review. An attacker who tries to harbor hundreds of wallets pays a rising per-identity surcharge drawn from that operator's pooled funds, so extra identities cost the operator real money, not the disposable wallet.
